title: Slow Kyoto morning, back to Tokyo, fireworks night
summary: What happened. A sleep in and packing instead of Nijō and a breakfast out, the Nozomi back to Tokyo, then the fireworks and buffet at the Hilton Odaiba as planned.

rows.detail: No alarm. Most of the packing before breakfast so the morning stays slow.

rows.what: Check out, taxi to Kyoto Station
rows.detail: About 5 minutes with the bags in the rain. Walking is 15 minutes in the dry (How-to 16).
Lunch on the train buys you the morning. Fair trade.
Lost one AirPod on the train. The hotel is posting it to the Blossom, due Sunday.

rows.what: Tokyo Station, Yaesu side taxi rank
rows.detail: Allow 15 minutes to clear the station. Saturday afternoon is busy. Ten to fifteen minutes to the hotel, roughly ¥1,500 to ¥2,000.

rows.what: Check in at Hotel The Blossom Hibiya
rows.detail: Pre-registered if the hotel allows it, so arrival is keys only. An hour to shower and change. Take a layer, the bay is cool after dark.

rows.what: Walk to Shimbashi, Yurikamome to Daiba
rows.detail: About 15 minutes on the train. Go early, it gets crowded by 17:00. Sit at the front for the Rainbow Bridge loop.
Next to Daiba station. Collect the wristbands and find the viewing area before it fills. Sunset is about 16:55.

rows.what: Fireworks from the Hilton's private viewing area

rows.detail: A few minutes' walk from the Hilton on the waterfront, lit up with Rainbow Bridge behind it. Skip it if you are done.

rows.what: Yurikamome back to Shimbashi, walk to the hotel
rows.detail: Pizza near the hotel on the way back.

footnote: Rain most of the morning, light (1 to 2 mm an hour), clearing mid-afternoon. Taxi with the bags. Work back from the 12:01: on the platform by 11:45, at the station by 11:15, check out about 10:45.
